title: Concept Steering for Reducing AI Paternalism Without Increasing Harm

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extracting an over-refusal concept vector from contrastive pairs (appropriate refusal vs. false refusal) is well-suited to beginners. The evaluation on a mixed benchmark is standard. Medium compute sufficient.
